definition.name: Isolating transformer
definition.description: Separates input and output circuits with a declared transformation ratio.

terminals.label: L
terminals.purpose: Line conductor: the alternating supply relative to neutral.

terminals.label: N
terminals.purpose: Neutral: the normal return path. It is not a protective conductor.

terminals.label: PE
terminals.purpose: Protective connection to the represented exposed conductive parts or protective network. It carries no intended normal load return and remains independent of switching the active conductors.

Isolated AC secondary first winding end. The stable + identifier is a software label, not fixed DC polarity. Measure RMS voltage between + and −; secondary-to-earth common-mode voltage is undetermined without a reference connection.

Isolated AC secondary second winding end. The stable - identifier is a software label, not fixed DC polarity. Measure RMS voltage between + and −; secondary-to-earth common-mode voltage is undetermined without a reference connection.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The enclosure supports and separates functional parts. This original teaching model is representative equipment, not a manufacturer drawing.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: The cover limits access to internal connections. Opening it here is a virtual inspection operation.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: Metal clamps establish connections to individual conductors. The circuit engine connects terminal IDs, not the apparent proximity of 3D wires.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: Mounting hardware supports the equipment. Screws, rail clips and glands are modelled separately from electrical connections.

parts.name: Windings
parts.purpose: Conductive windings couple electrical and magnetic behaviour. Motor and transformer windings use documented steady-state educational models.

parts.name: Isolation boundary
parts.purpose: The model separates the mains circuit from the output circuit. Voltage within a floating output can be meaningful while its voltage to earth is undetermined.
